definitions: If something is on the back burner, it is temporarily not being dealt with or considered, because it is not urgent or important.
A matter or plan that is on the back burner is being given low priority.
examples: We've had to put our holiday plans on the back burner for a while.
The project was put on the back burner due to lack of funding.
She decided to put her career on the back burner to raise her children.
